description: Restore the local mo skills install/list/get/path command group in the .NET CLI for version-matched Mohist coder-agent skill guidance.

tasks.title: Package built-in skill assets
tasks.description: Add or restore packaged full skill-data for the visible Mohist built-in skills, initially mohist and mohist-explore. Ensure the CLI package can resolve SKILL.md plus deterministic references/templates content without relying on repository-local installed stubs.
acceptanceCriteria: Packaged skill-data contains mohist/SKILL.md and mohist-explore/SKILL.md with valid AgentSkills frontmatter.
Packaged skill-data includes supplementary references/templates files when present, including mohist/references/issue-templates.md if available.
The visible built-in asset set excludes user-created skills such as mohist-po unless explicitly registered as built-ins.
The assets are included in development/test and published CLI layouts.
tasks.output: Packaged CLI skill-data assets for mohist and mohist-explore
tasks.notes: Choose the smallest reliable asset packaging approach for .NET CLI execution; do not serve content from installed .agents or .claude stubs.

tasks.title: Implement skill asset service
tasks.description: Create the local service or equivalent CLI component that exposes explicit built-in skill metadata, asset path resolution, content reads, JSON-ready data, and deterministic ordering. Support MOHIST_SKILLS_DIR as a development/test override for asset resolution only.
acceptanceCriteria: The service returns visible built-in skills sorted by name and includes at least mohist and mohist-explore.
The service resolves SKILL.md content from packaged assets or MOHIST_SKILLS_DIR when set to a valid asset root.
Unknown skill names produce a clear failure result suitable for non-zero CLI exit.
Full-content reads append references/ and templates/ files in deterministic sorted order.
The service does not scan, create, update, delete, or otherwise touch .mohist/skills.
tasks.output: Local built-in skill registry and asset resolver used by CLI commands
tasks.notes: Keep built-in visibility explicit so local or experimental directories cannot leak into list/install output.

tasks.title: Register skills command group
tasks.description: Register the .NET CLI mo skills command group with install, list, get, and path subcommands. Ensure help describes coder-agent skill management and that no update subcommand is registered.
acceptanceCriteria: mo skills --help displays help for managing coder agent skills.
Help lists install, list, get, and path subcommands.
Help does not list update.
mo skills update is not accepted as a registered command.
Command registration does not start or require the Mohist server.
tasks.output: Registered mo skills CLI command group without update
tasks.notes: Commands are local filesystem operations and should remain independent of Orleans/server services.

tasks.title: Implement OpenCode and Claude stub installs
tasks.description: Implement mo skills install for the default OpenCode target, explicit --path target, and --claude target. These modes should install lightweight discovery stubs for each built-in skill and refresh existing Mohist-managed built-in targets by overwriting the built-in SKILL.md files.
acceptanceCriteria: mo skills install writes mohist and mohist-explore stubs under <cwd>/.agents/skills/.
mo skills install --path <repo> writes only under <repo>/.agents/skills/ and does not write to the current working directory unless it is the selected target.
mo skills install --claude writes mohist and mohist-explore stubs under .claude/skills/ and does not write .agents/skills/.
Each installed stub has valid AgentSkills frontmatter with matching name and description.
Each installed stub points to mo skills get <name> and is not the full packaged guidance.
Re-running install overwrites older built-in mohist and mohist-explore stubs with current stub content.
User-authored skill directories such as mohist-po are not created, overwritten, deleted, or scanned.
tasks.notes: Overwrite by explicit built-in name only; do not clean or enumerate unrelated target directories.

tasks.title: Implement Hermes full installs
tasks.description: Implement mo skills install --hermes as a full packaged skill-data copy into ${HERMES_HOME:-~/.hermes}/skills. Validate incompatible options before any writes and keep Hermes config files untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: mo skills install --hermes copies full packaged mohist and mohist-explore directories under ${HERMES_HOME:-~/.hermes}/skills/.
When HERMES_HOME is set, install targets $HERMES_HOME/skills/ and does not write to the default ~/.hermes/skills/.
Installed Hermes SKILL.md files contain full packaged guidance and are not lightweight discovery stubs.
Hermes install does not install or modify user-created skills such as mohist-po.
--hermes combined with --path or --claude fails with a clear validation error before writing any skill files.
Hermes install does not read or mutate config.yaml or skills.external_dirs.
First install reports created, repeat install reports updated, and output includes usage examples for /mohist and /mohist-explore plus reload/reset guidance.
tasks.output: Working --hermes install behavior with validation and reporting
tasks.notes: Validate mode conflicts before creating target directories. Full-copy behavior consumes packaged assets from T-001 through the service from T-002.

tasks.title: Implement list get and path output
tasks.description: Implement mo skills list, get, get --full, get --all, and path using the packaged skill service. Support deterministic text output and required JSON forms for list, get, and path.
acceptanceCriteria: mo skills list prints visible built-in skills sorted by name and includes mohist and mohist-explore.
mo skills list --json returns structured sorted entries including name and description.
mo skills get mohist prints packaged full guidance, independent of any repository-installed stub.
mo skills get mohist --json returns name, description, and full guidance content.
mo skills get mohist --full appends references/ and templates/ files in deterministic sorted order.
mo skills get --all emits all visible built-in skills in deterministic name order.
mo skills path mohist prints the packaged directory path, and --json includes name and path.
Unknown skill names for get or path print a clear error and exit non-zero.
Commands complete without a running Mohist server and do not touch .mohist/skills.
tasks.output: Working list/get/path command output and error behavior
tasks.notes: If parser permits flag combinations not specified by the spec, choose deterministic behavior and cover it in tests or reject clearly.

tasks.title: Align README and shipped stubs
tasks.description: Update current user documentation and shipped discovery stubs to match the restored command surface. Document rerunning mo skills install as the refresh workflow and remove stale mo skills update guidance unless update was explicitly implemented as an alias, which this issue does not require.
acceptanceCriteria: README documents mo skills install as both initial install and refresh for coder-agent skills.
README documents the restored install/list/get/path surface and does not document mo skills update.
Shipped mohist and mohist-explore discovery stubs point agents to mo skills get <name> for full guidance.
Documentation distinguishes OpenCode/Claude discovery stubs from Hermes full packaged installs where relevant.
Documentation does not instruct users to manually maintain repository-local full skill copies.
tasks.output: README and shipped skill stubs aligned with restored commands
tasks.notes: Keep docs scoped to coder-agent skills, not Mohist runtime/internal .mohist/skills.

tasks.title: Add skills CLI test coverage
tasks.description: Add tests that exercise the restored command group end to end through the CLI surface and local filesystem effects. Cover command registration, install behavior, target separation, content serving, error handling, override behavior, and boundaries around internal Mohist skills.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests verify mo skills help lists install/list/get/path and not update.
Tests verify default install creates stubs and overwrites older built-in stubs.
Tests verify --path, --claude, and --hermes target separation and incompatible Hermes option rejection without writes.
Tests verify Hermes installs full packaged skill data, respects HERMES_HOME, excludes mohist-po, and leaves config.yaml untouched.
Tests verify list/list --json/get/get --json/get --full/get --all/path/path --json output and sorted deterministic ordering.
Tests verify unknown skill get/path errors are clear and non-zero.
Tests verify MOHIST_SKILLS_DIR override resolves test assets.
Tests verify no command creates, scans, updates, or deletes .mohist/skills.
Relevant .NET test command passes.
tasks.output: Automated tests covering restored mo skills behavior
tasks.notes: Use isolated temp directories for cwd, --path targets, HERMES_HOME, and MOHIST_SKILLS_DIR to prove server independence and avoid user filesystem mutation.
